steps: LISP->ORHK: each letter maps to its mirror (L->O, I->R, S->H, P->K)
B: YKFU fails (O->K wrong); C: YMHV fails (O->L needed); D: YKFW fails
check_code:
opts=['YLGV', 'YKFU', 'YMHV', 'YKFW']
f=lambda w:''.join(chr(155-ord(c)) for w in [w] for c in w)
assert f('LISP')=='ORHK' and f('WAND')=='DZMW'
r=f('BOTE')
assert r==opts[0]
assert all(r!=o for o in opts[1:])

method: Compare positions with alphabetically sorted word

n=sum(a==b for a,b in zip(w,s))
assert n==opts[1]

steps: Cycle CARETCR fits all given letters
check_code:
opts=['CRCEC', 'CERCC', 'CRECC', 'CRCCE']
s=('CARETCR'*5)[:30]
given='CARET_RCA_ETCRCAR_TCR_ARET_RCA'
assert len(given)==30
assert all(g=='_' or g==c for g,c in zip(given,s))
r=''.join(c for g,c in zip(given,s) if g=='_')
assert r==opts[2]
assert all(r!=o for o in (opts[0],opts[1],opts[3]))

steps: Neighbouring, Close are synonyms; Accommodating unrelated
check_code:
opts=['Neighbouring', 'Accommodating', 'Close', 'Distant']
ant={'Tame':'Wild','Adjacent':'Distant'}
r=ant['Adjacent']
assert r==opts[3]
assert all(r!=o for o in opts[:3])

steps: P+Q: P husband of Q; Q x R: R sister of Q; R - S: S mother of R; S / T: S daughter of T
So Q is daughter of S, S is daughter of T
check_code:
opts=['Sister', 'Daughter’s daughter', 'Mother’s mother', 'Daughter’s husband']
# chain from T: T -> S is daughter; S -> Q is daughter (R,Q sisters, S mother)
chain=['daughter','daughter']
r=chain[0]+'’s '+chain[1]
r=r[0].upper()+r[1:]
assert r==opts[1]
assert all(r!=o for o in (opts[0],opts[2],opts[3]))
